duplication_audit.novel_axis: past-only Hmax/Hs normalized extreme-wave ratio distribution, displacement and trend over full and recent context
duplication_audit.distinction: v21 and the older atmosphere pilot use only the current Hmax/Hs scalar as a router diagnostic; v71 models an OLS equilibrium residual between Hs and Hmax; generic sequence encoders ingest raw Hs/Hmax. None stores the sealed historical ratio distribution, endpoint displacement, or ratio trend, so v81 is not reconstructible from their outputs and uses no prior predictions.
duplication_audit.full_registry_boundary: Distinct from v29-v80 recurrence, spectrum, decomposition, tail-of-increments, crossing, record, topology, causality, covariance, intrinsic-time, gust, and prior-output families.
duplication_audit.repository_negative_fingerprint: No executed P3 historical Hmax/Hs ratio-distribution residual contract was found.
duplication_audit.official_exclusion: v64 and all prior/official results are excluded from features, gates, fitting and candidate selection

encoder.input: past-only Hs and Hmax on the native context, linearly filled within the observed prefix and sampled on the fixed 20-minute grid

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Forristall, On the statistical distribution of wave heights in a storm, Journal of Geophysical Research 83(C5), 2353-2358 (1978)
primary_sources.use: normalization of high-wave behavior by significant wave height motivation only; no P3 performance claim
